authUnavailable.title: Sign-in is unavailable
authUnavailable.unreachable: The authentication service could not be reached. Try again in a few minutes, or contact your administrator if the problem continues.
authUnavailable.insecureContext: Sign-in needs a secure connection. Open Tamiza over HTTPS (or on localhost) and try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page does not exist, or it is not available yet.

errors.network: Tamiza could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

kobo.invalid_url: Enter the server's full address, for example https://kf.kobotoolbox.org.
kobo.https_required: The Kobo server must use HTTPS.
kobo.address_not_allowed: This Kobo server's address points to a private or local network, which this installation does not allow.
kobo.unauthorized: Kobo rejected the API token, or the token cannot read this form and its submissions.
kobo.form_not_found: No form with this asset UID was found on the Kobo server.
kobo.unreachable: The Kobo server could not be reached. Check the address and try again.
kobo.unexpected_response: The Kobo server answered unexpectedly. Check the address and try again.
kobo.token_unreadable: The saved API token can no longer be read. A project admin must replace it.
kobo.version_not_found: Kobo has no such version of this form.
kobo.rate_limited: The Kobo server is limiting Tamiza's requests. Tamiza will try again later.

member.exists: This person is already a member of the project.

invitation.exists: This email already has a pending invitation.

project.last_admin: The project needs at least one admin. Make someone else admin first.

sync.in_progress: A synchronization of this project is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.
sync.interrupted: The synchronization was interrupted because the server stopped. The next one runs normally.
sync.failed: The synchronization failed because of an unexpected error. An administrator can find the details in the API log.

webhook.unsupported_media_type: Kobo sent the submission as XML. Edit the REST Service in Kobo and choose the JSON type.
webhook.invalid_submission: Kobo sent a submission without its _id or _uuid. Leave the REST Service field subset and custom wrapper empty.
webhook.too_large: The submission is larger than Tamiza accepts.

run.already_queued: A run of this project is already waiting to start.
run.interrupted: The run was interrupted because the analytics worker stopped. The next run proceeds normally.

limit.time: A script exceeded the time limit and was stopped.
limit.memory: A script exceeded the memory limit and was stopped.

script.not_set: There is no script to remove.

test.interrupted: The test was interrupted because the analytics worker stopped. Test again.

reference.exists: The project already has a reference table with this name. Replace it from the list, or choose another name.
reference.limit: The project already has 50 reference tables. Delete one before adding another.

dashboard.timeout: Computing the dashboard took too long and was stopped. Try a shorter date range, or try again in a few minutes.

projects.title: Projects
projects.emptyBody: A project links Tamiza to one KoboToolbox form. Create one to start, or ask a project admin to invite you.

createProject.title: New project
createProject.intro: Connect a KoboToolbox form. Tamiza checks that the token can read the form and its submissions before saving.
createProject.name: Project name
createProject.serverUrlHint: The full HTTPS address of your Kobo server.
createProject.assetUidHint: In Kobo, open the form: it is the code after /forms/ in the address, for example aBcD1234eFgH.
createProject.apiTokenHint: In Kobo: Account settings → Security → API key. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
createProject.created: Project {{ name }} created. Now connect Kobo's webhook.

project.notFoundBody: It does not exist, or you are not a member of it.

overview.tokenUnreadable: The saved Kobo API token can no longer be read (the encryption keys changed). Replace the token and regenerate the webhook secret.
overview.checkIntro: Which dashboard metrics the form and the sampling frame allow. Missing fields can be added to the form in Kobo.
overview.enumeratorHint: The question that identifies who collected each submission.
overview.unavailableVersionsOne: 1 form version has no labels yet. Its answers use the current form's labels until Tamiza can read it.
overview.unavailableVersions: {{ count }} form versions have no labels yet. Their answers use the current form's labels until Tamiza can read them.

hints.defineSamplingFrame: Define a sampling frame to see coverage.
hints.defineSamplingFrameViewer: Ask an analyst or admin to define the sampling frame.
hints.updateSamplingFrame: The sampling frame uses fields the form no longer has. Update the frame, or put those questions back in the form.
hints.updateSamplingFrameViewer: The sampling frame uses fields the form no longer has. Ask an analyst or admin to update it.
hints.selectEnumeratorField: Select the question that identifies the enumerator below.
hints.selectEnumeratorFieldViewer: Ask a project admin to select the question that identifies the enumerator.

overview.timeZoneHint: The dashboard counts each day in this time zone. Names follow the IANA database, for example America/Bogota.

performance.daysUtcAction: Set the project time zone in the Overview.
performance.daysZone: Days are counted in the {{ zone }} time zone.

submissions.title: Submissions
submissions.noDays: No submissions with a reception time in this period.
submissions.chartLabel: Bar chart of submissions per day, from {{ first }} to {{ last }}: {{ total }} submissions in {{ days }} days, at most {{ peak }} in one day. The table view lists every day.

completion.title: Completion time
completion.fences: Outliers are surveys shorter than {{ lower }} min or longer than {{ upper }} min. Durations that cannot be used (end before start, or a missing or invalid time) are left out of every figure.
completion.noneUsable: No submission has a usable duration in this period.
completion.unavailable: Completion time needs the form to record when each survey starts and ends. Missing in the form: {{ fields }}.
completion.howTo: In Kobo, enable the start and end metadata of the form, deploy it again, then re-check it in the Overview.

enumerators.title: Enumerators
enumerators.name: Enumerator
enumerators.unavailable: Tamiza cannot tell who collected each submission: the form has no username field and no question is selected as the enumerator.
enumerators.adminHow: Select the question that identifies the enumerator.
enumerators.askAdmin: Ask a project admin to select the question that identifies the enumerator.

coverage.title: Sampling frame coverage
coverage.none: No sampling frame is defined for this project.
coverage.noneEditor: Define the combinations and targets to follow how the fieldwork covers them.
coverage.noneViewer: An analyst or admin can define it.

warning.missingField: The dimension {{ name }} maps to {{ field }}, a field the form no longer has.
warning.repeat: The dimension {{ name }} cannot be counted because its question ({{ field }}) is answered once per repeat.
warning.multipleChoice: The dimension {{ name }} cannot be counted because an answer to {{ field }} can hold several choices.

coverage.overallHelp: Surveys above a target do not make up for another combination falling short.
coverage.overallNone: No combination has a target above 0.
coverage.outsideHelp: Submissions that match no combination of the frame, or leave a dimension empty.
coverage.outsideTop: Most frequent combinations outside the frame
coverage.noRows: The sampling frame has no combinations.

data.activeSync: {{ kind }} in progress. This page updates by itself.
data.fullSyncMessage: A full resync reads every submission from Kobo again. It picks up edits made in Kobo that the webhook did not deliver, and marks submissions deleted in Kobo. Large forms can take several minutes.
data.intervalHint: Catches submissions the webhook missed. From 1 to 168 hours.
data.reconcileHint: Marks submissions deleted in Kobo. From 1 to 168 hours.
data.countsSummary: {{ created }} new, {{ updated }} updated, {{ deleted }} deleted

versions.title: Form versions
versions.intro: Answers to select questions are shown with the labels of the form version their submission was made with.
versions.empty: No form versions yet. They appear as submissions arrive.
versions.withoutVersion: {{ count }} submissions have no form version. Their answers use the current form's labels.
versions.withoutVersionOne: 1 submission has no form version. Its answers use the current form's labels.
versions.retryHint: Re-checking the form retries failed and not found versions.

scripts.title: Scripts

contracts.clean: clean(raw, ctx) receives the flattened tables and returns the cleaned ones. Without it, the flattened tables are the clean data.
contracts.output: prepare_output(cleaned, ctx) returns the tables for the clean-data dashboard. Optional.
contracts.indicators: compute_indicators(cleaned, ctx) returns one table with indicator, disaggregation, value, numerator and denominator. Optional.

scripts.saved: Version {{ number }} saved. It is used from the next run.
scripts.removed: Script removed (version {{ number }}). The next run uses the default behavior.
scripts.tooLarge: The script is larger than 200 KB.
scripts.viewingVersion: Viewing version {{ number }} by {{ author }}. It is read-only.

removeMessage.clean: From the next run, the flattened tables are published as the clean data. Earlier versions stay in the history.
removeMessage.output: From the next run, no output tables are published. Earlier versions stay in the history.
removeMessage.indicators: From the next run, no indicator table is published. Earlier versions stay in the history.

scripts.discardMessage: The edits to this script have not been saved.

runs.title: Runs
runs.started: Run queued. It starts within seconds.
runs.empty: No runs yet. A run starts after a synchronization with new data, on the schedule, or with Run now.
runs.noReference: This run used no reference tables.

pipeline.runAfterSync: Run after each synchronization that brings new, changed or deleted submissions
pipeline.intervalHint: From 1 to 168 hours. Leave empty for no schedule.

webhook.title: Webhook settings
webhook.intro: Kobo sends each new submission to this address as it arrives. Enter these values in the form's REST Services.
webhook.secretUnreadable: The webhook secret can no longer be read. Regenerate it and update Kobo.

steps.register: Choose Register a new service and give it a name.
steps.type: Keep JSON as the type. Leave the field subset and the custom wrapper empty.
steps.auth: Under Security choose Basic Authorization and paste the username and password.

webhook.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
webhook.regenerateMessage: Kobo stops being able to send submissions until you update the password in its REST Service.
webhook.regenerated: New secret generated. Update it in Kobo.
webhook.noDelivery: No delivery received yet. Once the REST Service is saved in Kobo, new submissions appear in the Data section within seconds.

members.inviteIntro: Enter the email the person uses in Keycloak. If they have not signed in to Tamiza yet, the invitation waits until they do with that email verified. Tamiza does not send email: let them know.
members.title: Members
members.name: Name
members.invited: Invitation saved. {{ email }} becomes a member on their first sign-in with that email verified.
members.removeMessage: They lose access to this project immediately.
members.revokeMessage: Signing in with this email will no longer add them to the project.

frame.emptyViewer: No sampling frame has been defined for this project yet.
frame.importIntro: Upload a CSV or XLSX file with one column per dimension and a target column, one combination per row. You can review it before saving.
frame.previewSummary: {{ rows }} rows and {{ dimensions }} dimensions found.
frame.previewErrors: Fix these rows in the file and import it again:
frame.dimensionsIntro: Each dimension maps to a question of the form, for example municipality or sex.
frame.addDimensionFirst: Add a dimension to start entering targets.
frame.errorCount: {{ count }} problems to fix before saving.
frame.importApplied: The imported rows are in the editor. Review them and save.

scriptTests.sampleSizeRange: Enter a whole number of submissions from {{ min }} to {{ max }}.
scriptTests.title: Test of {{ kind }} on {{ size }} submissions
scriptTests.stale: The editor has changed since this test. Test again to see the result of the current code.
scriptTests.waitingForRun: Waiting for a run to finish. The test starts right after it.
scriptTests.waitingForTest: Waiting for another test to finish.
scriptTests.succeeded: The test succeeded. Save the script to use it in the next run.
scriptTests.previewTrimmed: First {{ shown }} of {{ rows }} rows: fewer are shown to keep the preview under 1 MB.
scriptTests.noPreview: {{ rows }} rows. Only the first 20 tables of a step are previewed.

reference.title: Reference data
reference.intro: Tables your scripts read by name, for example population projections or municipality codes: ctx.reference["population"].
reference.emptyEditor: No reference tables yet. Upload a CSV or XLSX file; scripts read it with ctx.reference["name"] from the next run.
reference.emptyViewer: This project has no reference tables.
reference.uploadIntro: CSV (UTF-8, comma or semicolon) or XLSX (first sheet), up to 10 MB. The first non-empty row is the header; column types are detected from the values.
reference.name: Table name
reference.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. Scripts use it in ctx.reference.
reference.fileRequired: Choose a CSV or XLSX file.
reference.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
reference.uploaded: Reference table {{ name }} uploaded. Scripts can read it from the next run.
reference.replaced: Reference table {{ name }} replaced. Scripts read the new rows from the next run.
reference.renamed: Columns of {{ name }} renamed for scripts:
reference.replaceMessage: The rows and columns of {{ name }} will be those of {{ file }}. Runs that already started keep the current rows.
reference.deleteMessage: Scripts that read ctx.reference["{{ name }}"] fail from the next run.
reference.previewNote: First {{ shown }} of {{ rows }} rows, from {{ file }}.
